classification.difficultyReason: Source Mastery problem requiring four successive remaining fractions of a harvest.

answer.worked:
The fractions kept after Monkeys A, B, C and D eat are $\frac{1}{2}$, $\frac{2}{3}$, $\frac{3}{4}$ and $\frac{4}{5}$ respectively.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Fraction remaining}&=\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{2}{3}\times\frac{3}{4}\times\frac{4}{5}\\&=\frac{1\times2\times3\times4}{2\times3\times4\times5}\\&=\frac{1}{5}\end{align*}$$
One fifth remains.
